===Symbol===

# The cardinal number [[forty-two]].

====Usage notes====
* The number 42 is often given as a joking [[answer]] to the question of the meaning of [[life]], the [[universe]], and [[everything]], and is sometimes used as an example value in [[programming]] where a [[number]] is desired, in reference to ''{{w|The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy}}''.
